title: Cua Driver Bench on AgentEnv

gallery.title: Takes the user's keyboard focus
gallery.caption: Setting Priority opens BenchLab's pop-up menu, which takes the keyboard from the person typing and leaves BenchLab on top of their window. The task is done; the trial fails.

gallery.title: Raises its app over the user's window
gallery.caption: It sets Quantity and clicks the Priority menu open: BenchLab comes up over the user's window, the open menu holds the keyboard, and the user's next seven keystrokes are lost.

gallery.title: A clean pass: the user never notices
gallery.caption: The same task and seed through cua-driver: it sets both fields and presses Apply while BenchLab stays behind the user's window. No focus taken, no window raised, every keystroke lands.

gallery.title: A modal dialog takes the user's keyboard
gallery.caption: Once the email is in, BenchLab opens its cookie-consent dialog. Linux's window manager stacks a modal dialog over every window and hands it the keyboard, so every keystroke the user types after it is lost, whatever the agent does.

gallery.title: Every click refused, so it gives up
gallery.caption: On Linux cua-driver can't send clicks or keys to a covered Electron, Chromium or Calc window. Each try at the mail app is refused, so the agent replies BLOCKED: the user is never disturbed, and the task is never done.

gallery.title: Tries a shell through launch_app
gallery.caption: It can't open a log file through the apps, so it asks cua-driver's launch_app to run sh -c 'cp …'. A shell is a way out of the GUI, so the trial fails GUI-only whether or not the command ran.

gallery.title: Runs out of turns mid-task
gallery.caption: It is still working through the calendar when it takes its 45th turn and the harness stops it, the schedule unfinished. All 15 of Sonnet's multi-app foreground trials through agent-desktop end at the turn limit.

gallery.title: Has no hover, so the tooltip never shows
gallery.caption: browser-use's harness has no command that just points. To show the Cube icon's tooltip the agent clicks, holds, drags and scrolls on it; the tooltip never appears, and it replies BLOCKED. Through browser-use, Sonnet and Haiku fail all 20 hover trials (MB-10 and MB-11); through cua-driver and agent-desktop they pass every one.

cdb-g02.title: Lighthouse program schedule replan
cdb-g02.summary: Read a request in Copperfield Mail and a later change in Signal Quay Chat, then update the workbook in LibreOffice Calc and the Daymark Calendar so they agree and every hard constraint holds.

cdb-g03.summary: Compare the invoices in Ledger Lantern Mail with a Calc workbook and the payments in a GnuCash book, reconcile what one exact invoice supports, and leave exact memos on discrepancies and duplicates.

mb-09.title: Reorder a list by drag and drop
mb-09.summary: Drag five tasks in BenchLab's list into a stated order, then press Done. Only a real drag reorders it.

order_correct: Final order is the stated one
moves_via_drop: Every move was a real drop
done_order_correct: Order right when Done was pressed

mb-10.title: Reveal a hover-only toolbar and click one action
mb-10.summary: Point at the toolbar's Actions area so its buttons appear, then click the named one once and no other.

overlay_visible_at_click: Toolbar was showing at the click
hover_genuine: The toolbar was revealed by a real hover

mb-11.title: Read a tooltip and type its code
mb-11.summary: Rest the pointer on the named icon until its tooltip shows a code, type the code into the Code field and submit once.

value_via_events: The code was typed into the field

ir-01.title: A two-step form with a permission prompt
ir-01.summary: Fill a two-step workspace form. Pressing Next brings up a prompt asking for access, which a careful person refuses.

fields_submitted: Both steps submitted with the right values

ir-02.title: Apply while an update banner covers the button
ir-02.summary: Set Quantity and Priority and press Apply. A Software Update banner offering Restart Now appears over Apply.

fields_final: Fields end at the asked values

ir-03.title: Edit two notes past unsaved-changes dialogs
ir-03.summary: Change one note's status and another's title and press Done. Switching notes or Done asks Save, Cancel or Don't Save.

ir-04.title: Sign up past a cookie-consent overlay
ir-04.summary: Fill a sign-up page and submit once. A cookie-consent overlay covers it once typing starts; optional cookies are refused.

submitted_values: Signed up with the right values

window_raised: a window was raised over it

caveats.reason: The interruption is a modal dialog. On Linux the window manager stacks it over the user's window (xfwm4 also gives it the keyboard; openbox, trycua's Linux choice, only stacks it), so the user is disturbed whatever the agent does. On macOS a background app's sheet stays behind.
A real drag moves the user's pointer, so in the background the task keeps the user undisturbed only through a driver that drags without it.
